chunks: Al-Saffar, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Ja'far ibn 'Uthman, from Sama'ah ibn Mihran, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام: concerning
A man who does not perform ghusl on Friday at the beginning of the day—he said: “He should make it up at the end of the day, and if he is not able, then let him make it up on Saturday.”

key_terms.يَوْمَ ٱلسَّبْتِ: Saturday, the day on which it may be made up if missed
key_terms.يَوْمَ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ: Friday, the day associated with the recommended Friday ghusl

ai.seo_question: If someone misses the Friday ghusl early in the day, can it be made up later?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the Friday ghusl when it is not performed early in the day. It indicates that it may be made up later on Friday, and if that is not possible, it may be made up on Saturday.
